sections.heading: Planning your Fernvale Sails interior
sections.text:
Fernvale is a residential pocket of Sengkang, a north-eastern town that has been built out in stages. Owners who are close to keys usually want a first fit-out that works as a long stay: a fitted kitchen, full-height wardrobes, an entry shoe cabinet, and a living-room storage wall, rather than a temporary set of loose furniture. Maison designs that work as built-in carpentry, not as IKEA-style furniture, and we can present it in a wide room view or in closer material studies. No official floor plan is on file, so typologies are not listed, and we will not invent a typical Fernvale Sails layout or a water view from the name.

Matilda Riverside in Punggol and Tanjong Tree Residences @ Hougang are nearby north-east links in this batch; they are not typologies or key-date references for Fernvale Sails. We will not invent walking times to Sengkang town, to Fernvale, or to any MRT station. Check your block, facing and the HDB renovation rules before you plan blinds, a window bench or any hacking, and do not start work from a tracker month.

After keys, inspect defects, measure, and obtain the HDB renovation permit before fabrication. A moderate carpentry scope is often planned at six to ten weeks on site after approvals, as an editorial planning figure only. WhatsApp Maison with your approved plan and any key letter you have. We are not affiliated with HDB.
